---
title: "QoL unadjusted landmark — estimand"
subtitle: "Pooled unadjusted treatment odds for a worse six-month outcome"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Five hundred deterministically selected posterior treatment draws are retained
from each of primary QoL imputations 1–5. Equal numbers of draws give every
completed dataset equal weight. Odds ratios below one favour intervention.

```{r}
#| label: derive-supporting-qol-unadjusted-estimand
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- config$imputation$supporting$indices
model_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "qol-unadjusted-landmark", "models"
)
estimand_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "qol-unadjusted-landmark", "estimand"
)
result_dir <- here::here(
  "results", "supporting", "qol-unadjusted-landmark"
)
figure_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "qol-unadjusted-landmark", "figures"
)
dir.create(estimand_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (index in indices) {
  draw_path <- file.path(estimand_dir, sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!force && file.exists(draw_path)) next

  model <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)))
  draws <- as.data.frame(model$draws)
  if (!"tx" %in% names(draws)) {
    stop("The unadjusted QoL posterior does not contain the coefficient `tx`.")
  }
  set.seed(analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 450L))
  selected <- sample.int(
    nrow(draws),
    config$imputation$supporting$post_estimation_draws,
    replace = FALSE
  )
  estimand <- tibble::tibble(
    imputation = index,
    draw = seq_len(config$imputation$supporting$post_estimation_draws),
    log_odds_ratio_worse = draws$tx[selected],
    odds_ratio_worse = exp(log_odds_ratio_worse)
  )
  arrow::write_parquet(estimand, draw_path, compression = "zstd")
}

draws <- purrr::map_dfr(indices, function(index) {
  arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index)
  ))
})

summary <- draws |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    estimand = paste(
      "unadjusted proportional odds ratio for a worse six-month",
      "QoL/death state"
    ),
    posterior_mean = mean(odds_ratio_worse),
    posterior_median = median(odds_ratio_worse),
    q025 = quantile(odds_ratio_worse, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    q975 = quantile(odds_ratio_worse, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(log_odds_ratio_worse < 0),
    imputations = dplyr::n_distinct(imputation),
    posterior_draws_per_imputation =
      config$imputation$supporting$post_estimation_draws,
    computationally_reduced = TRUE
  )

arrow::write_parquet(
  draws,
  file.path(result_dir, "estimand-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

posterior_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  draws,
  ggplot2::aes(x = odds_ratio_worse)
) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(side = "bottom") +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    .width = c(0.66, 0.95),
    point_interval = ggdist::median_qi
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Unadjusted treatment odds ratio for a worse six-month QoL/death state",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "qol-unadjusted-odds-ratio-posterior.png"),
  posterior_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
